meta.notes: Rows follow the approved 11-element scope from the current Elements page. Linked unit counts and examples are reference context only because the source page says listed units are shown for reference and are not ordered. Image paths are intentionally blank at the data gate; the image skill should download the 11 element icons into apps/web/public/Anime Vanguards/Elements/ and populate image fields.
imageNotes: Image pass downloaded one clean element icon per row from Fandom static image URLs resolved through MediaWiki imageinfo.
All element icons are stored under apps/web/public/Anime Vanguards/Elements and wired through public /Anime%20Vanguards/Elements/*.webp paths.
